## Summary
Frédéric Atlan has 20+ years of systems architecture and digital synthesis in the automotive industry (Renault Group / Ampere, PSA). He is moving into technical leadership for Data, AI & Cybersecurity, and runs an open R&D lab: he designs, audits and open-sources sovereign multi-agent architectures, reliable data pipelines and proof-based trust mechanisms. Not a shopfloor / MES digitalization profile.

## Current focus
- Moving into technical leadership: Data, AI & Cybersecurity (since November 2026)
- Open R&D lab (this site): sovereign multi-agent architectures, reliable data pipelines, proof-based trust mechanisms, published as open source

## Selected experience
- April 2024 – 16 November 2026 — Digital Synthesis Architect, Ampere (Renault Group), Guyancourt: multiphysics digital synthesis, organization design, model/data maturity at milestones, product ownership of a graph-based traceability platform, AI-assisted engineering workflows
- 2021–2024 — Corporate Technical Leader & Platform Architect, EV/hybrid simulation, Renault Group (HIL/MIL/SIL industrialization)
- 2018–2021 — Model Architect; built a France–India digital simulation factory (1 France lead + 11 India engineers); delivery quality from under 30% to ~98%
- 2010–2018 — Modeling referent hybrid/electric, PSA Group (Stellantis)
- Parallel — Founder, DataRefiners; Digital Project Lead on MarketChain (fintech inclusion, outside automotive)
